sources.title: Video URLs
sources.description: Direct links to video files (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, M4V, MPEG, 3GP…), up to 2 GB each. Pages like YouTube are not supported — use a direct file link. Files in your own Apify key-value store work too: set the store's access to "Anyone with ID can read" and use https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/<store ID>/records/<key>.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: count = N evenly spaced frames; interval = one frame every N seconds; timestamps = exact times; scenes = a frame at every scene change; keyframes = the video's keyframes (I-frames).

intervalSeconds.title: Interval, seconds (interval)
intervalSeconds.description: For mode interval: 1 = one frame per second, 0.5 = two per second.

timestamps.title: Timestamps (timestamps)
timestamps.description: For mode timestamps: seconds (90.5) or hh:mm:ss / mm:ss (01:30). Times past the end are skipped.

sceneThreshold.title: Scene sensitivity (scenes)
sceneThreshold.description: 0.1 = many frames (small changes count), 0.3 = default, 0.5 = only hard cuts.

format.title: Image format
format.description: JPG = small files, PNG = lossless, WebP = smallest.

maxWidth.title: Max width (px)
maxWidth.description: Downscale wider frames, keeping the aspect ratio. 0 = original size.

contactSheet.title: Contact sheet
contactSheet.description: Also return one image with all frames and timecodes (free).
